security_audit.summary: Most alerts are Markdown backticks or code fences, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. The skill does contain intentional installation and belt commands, and hosted app calls may send launch materials to third-party services.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends installing external skills and a CLI without a pinned version or integrity check.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted versions where supported, identify the package source, and tell users to review installation instructions before execution.

remediation.issue: Hosted image and search commands may transmit product details or local assets to third-party services.
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy warning and advise users to remove secrets, customer data, and confidential launch details before running hosted apps.

content.user_title: Plan a Strong Product Hunt Launch
content.value_statement: Product Hunt launches require coordinated copy, visuals, timing, and engagement. This skill turns product details into a structured preparation and launch-day plan.
actual_capabilities: Drafts Product Hunt taglines using five documented formulas and a 60-character target.
Plans a five-image gallery sequence with goals for each position.
Structures a maker comment with product, problem, differentiation, and feedback sections.
Builds preparation, launch-day, and post-launch checklists.
Provides belt commands for hosted image generation and competitor research.
limitations: It does not submit listings, schedule launches, or reply to comments.
Image and search workflows require the external belt CLI, authentication, and network access.
Platform limits and ranking behavior may change after the skill was published.
Generated visuals and claims require human review for accuracy, branding, and rights.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Startup Launch
use_cases.description: Create listing copy, a gallery sequence, and a launch-day timeline for a new software product.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Client Campaigns
use_cases.description: Turn approved positioning into launch assets, engagement tasks, and follow-up actions.

use_cases.title: Launch a Side Project
use_cases.description: Build a focused checklist and clear maker comment with limited time and resources.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Taglines
prompt_templates.prompt: Create ten Product Hunt taglines for [product]. The audience is [audience], and the main benefit is [benefit]. Keep each under 60 characters.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the Gallery
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan five Product Hunt gallery images for [product]. Describe each image, its message, required source assets, and one image-generation prompt.
prompt_templates.scenario: Organize the visual story before production.

prompt_templates.title: Write the Maker Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a maker comment for [product]. Include what it does, why we built it, the key difference, our next step, and a feedback question.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Full Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Product Hunt launch plan for [product] on [date]. Include readiness gaps, listing copy, gallery sequence, research tasks, timeline, engagement, and follow-up.

output_examples.input: Draft a tagline for an analytics tool that explains unusual metric changes.
Outline a gallery for a document automation product.
output: Hero: show the real editor turning a source file into a finished document.
Feature: show the template selection and field mapping workflow.
Transformation: compare manual formatting with the automated result.
Proof: present verified time savings with clear context.
Integrations: show supported storage and collaboration tools.

output_examples.input: Create a short launch-day engagement plan.
output_examples.output: Publish the maker comment immediately, monitor comments throughout the day, answer every question, and share the launch naturally in relevant communities.

best_practices: Verify current Product Hunt requirements before finalizing the listing.
Use real product screens and evidence instead of generic marketing visuals.
Review every generated claim, prompt, and image before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not ask users or communities for upvotes.
Do not publish vague taglines filled with unsupported superlatives.
Do not send confidential product or customer data to hosted tools.

faq.question: Does this skill publish my Product Hunt listing?
faq.answer: No. It prepares copy, visual plans, research commands, and checklists for manual execution.

faq.question: Do I need the belt CLI?
faq.answer: Only the hosted image and search examples require belt. The planning and writing guidance works without it.

faq.question: Can it generate gallery images?
faq.answer: It provides belt commands and prompts for external image services. You must review and export the resulting assets.

faq.question: Are the listed Product Hunt specifications guaranteed current?
faq.answer: No. Confirm current limits, supported formats, and policies on Product Hunt before launch.

faq.question: Can I use it for a non-software product?
faq.answer: Yes. Adapt the gallery, tagline, and maker comment guidance to show the product clearly and support truthful claims.

faq.question: How should I protect confidential information?
faq.answer: Remove secrets, personal data, customer records, and unreleased details before sending inputs to any hosted app.
